leaves.name: degEqDetTate
leaves.doc: Mumford, Abelian varieties (1970), section 19, Theorem 4, first assertion (numbering UNVERIFIED): for an endomorphism psi of an abelian variety over an algebraically closed field k and a prime l != char k, deg psi = det T_l(psi). Stated on V_l = Q_l (x) T_l in any finite basis (equal to the determinant on the free Z_l-module T_l), with deg the genuine degree degEnd: [K(A) : psi^* K(A)] (stalk map at the generic point) for psi finite and surjective, 0 otherwise (Mumford's convention for non-isogenies).
leaves.flag: unread: new printed leaf (Mumford 19 Thm 4, deg = det T_l; the field charPolyIndepOfEllAlgClosed is the other assertion of the same theorem, proved from this one plus homFreeFiniteAlgClosed); locator UNVERIFIED
leaves.source: Mumford, Abelian varieties, section 19, Theorem 4 (first assertion: deg phi = det T_l(phi))

note: charPolyIndepOfEllAlgClosed is proved from DegEqDetTate and the bundle's own field homFreeFiniteAlgClosed (only Module.Finite Z (End A) is used, for the integrality of phi over Z). Glue in Lean: det(n - V_l phi) = charpoly(V_l phi)(n) = deg(n - phi) for every integer n, Lagrange interpolation over Q, uniqueness across l, integer coefficients via the roots of the characteristic polynomial being roots of a monic integer polynomial (Mathlib isIntegral_coeff_of_factors).
